title: PROGRESS UNDER PM-JANMAN
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Tribal Affairs

PROGRESS UNDER PM-JANMAN

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
30 JUL 2026 1:32PM by PIB Delhi

Replying to a question in Lok Sabha today the Union Minister of State for Tribal Affairs Shri Durgadas Uikey informed that
 Pradhan Mantri Janjati Adivasi Nyaya Maha Abhiyan (PM JANMAN) was launched by the Hon'ble Prime Minister on 15th November, 2023 for the socio-economic development of the 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG) communities residing in 18 States including Gujarat and one Union Territory.

The mission aims to provide basic facilities to improve their socio-economic conditions such as safe housing, clean drinking water and improved access to education, health and nutrition, road and telecom connectivity, electrification of unelectrified households and sustainable livelihood opportunities. These objectives are being met through 11 interventions implemented by 9-line Ministries. The details of the benefits given under PM JANMAN, as on 30.06.2026, Ministry-wise & State-wise and District-wise in Gujarat, are given at
Annexure I.
 The progress so made under the abhiyan has contributed to the
socio-economic development of PVTGs through improvement in basic amenities and livelihood opportunities.

Ministry of Tribal Affairs through the State Governments/UT Administration/departments has undertaken habitation level data collection exercise through PM Gati Shakti mobile application to estimate PVTG population figures and infrastructure gaps in order to cover PVTG population residing in villages & habitations covered under PM JANMAN. Based on the data captured, State/UT- wise, PVTG villages, habitations and population is tabulated at
Annexure II
. The actual number beneficiaries to be covered under the abhiyan is subjected to eligibility criteria of specific guidelines of concerned interventions as per norms approved.
